m64_original_events.retreat_policy: Do not treat early retreat as the default fix. Retreating earlier can lose kills, refund value, healing coverage, or create an empty lane. Recompute the full handoff and successor availability.

requirements: Build a compact duty-end and handoff table in allowed schema explanation fields for key medical/output/blocking operators.
State each key operator's last necessary task, expected completion, and whether completion is calculable or a pending assumption.
For a planned living retreat, compute pressure before retreat, actual healer candidates, skill coverage, in-flight projectiles, and stacking damage.
For sacrifice or death, state killed enemies, released enemies, and the exact successor position/time/cost/block/attack capability.
For redeploy, verify cooldown/cost and whether enemies can still enter actual attack range. Do not assume a dead operator's refund or later skill.
Simultaneously close artillery, both protected-target routes, and #34 with actual contact and final settlement.
Compare at least three materially different structures, including whether revising M62's remaining gaps is preferable, but do not force a parent branch.
death_accounting_policy: Deaths are evaluated by contribution and handoff, not minimized. A sacrifice is valid only when its action is settled and remaining duties have a real successor.
user_confirmed_tactical_premise: Attack intervals, action occupancy, attack baiting, damage absorption, rotation, and valuable sacrifice may be used as design principles; do not represent them as new client-verified rules.

model_capability_constraints.ordinary_attack_targeting: Target is selected at ATTACK_STRIKE; reliable pre-swing target locking is not expressible.
model_capability_constraints.retreat_cooldown: Attack cooldown does not reset after the operator has actually attacked.
model_capability_constraints.artillery: Cast starts cooldown and target selection; projectile birth locks the landing point; delayed area hit follows.
model_capability_constraints.spot_skill: EXECUTABLE_APPROXIMATED only: initial SP 25/40, 25 seconds, ATK +45%, 1.3-second healing interval, x-4 range, no attacks while healing; physical-dodge talent is unsupported.
model_capability_constraints.ansel_probability_extra_heal: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; do not assume dual healing.

open_roster_revision_policy: Compare at least three materially different structures in one call, then autonomously select and output one complete executable plan. Do not force or exclude any operator; do not impose quotas or require sacrifice.
